caveats: Exactly the sidebar namespace-sort ADVANCED tag-display action is approved. No tag-service, collect, DefaultCollect, tag-display management, parent, alias or broader action-family completion receives credit.

All twelve namespace fixture cases have identical ordered media across modes 1/3/2 within each of four services. Exact media replay proves recorded routing and context preservation, not differentiated display-filter output. Production mode 2 maps to SingleMedia and mode 3 to SelectionList in source; no wider filter backend credit is claimed.

Physical input and four defining captures cover the my-tags service; the unchanged full sixteen-sort/eight-collect replay preserves all four services and existing contexts. The actual checked menu shows order 1/3/2, and both disabled and enabled save-default policies are assertion-backed.

Retained View IDs are rejected after a new opening, while the owner is hidden and after a page switch, preserving caller/successor contexts and defaults. The test explicitly clears embedded popups after hide/page switching as cleanup; automatic hidden-popup retirement and permanent retirement on arbitrary temporary hide are not claimed.

Qt references are real polished QMenu grabs obtained with PopupMenu presentation intercepted. They establish labels, order and check states, without displayed popup-placement, exact pixel, direct OS-native menu introspection or physical window-manager parity. Native fonts, row spacing, check glyphs and composite menu styling differ.

The root and three ADVANCED submenu states fit the inspected 1060 × 760 native viewport with full selected labels and checks. Underlying page/thumbnail/preview layout is supporting context and earns no additional credit; universal or narrow-viewport layout is not established.

The initial source 393c12553 failed because its restored input order was compared with a sorted reference baseline before a sort consumer ran. The repaired setup uses the ordinary sort consumer, adds an exact sorted-baseline assertion and preserves all 87 prior assertions. That failed run produced no defining captures and demonstrates no production right-click defect.

Validation is Linux only; Windows and macOS remain deferred. Registered repository metadata implies no network or repository work. The optional Qt API listener was unavailable; direct Qt/DB recording succeeded and supplies no API connectivity claim.
